animals.name: Dwarf Seahorse
animals.blurb: The slowest fish on Earth. It covers about five feet in an hour.

animals.name: Green Sea Turtle
animals.blurb: Unhurried and ancient, navigating by magnetic field.

animals.name: Leatherback Turtle
animals.blurb: Ambles across whole oceans, but the fastest reptile in the sea when it wants to be.

animals.name: Whale Shark
animals.blurb: The largest fish alive, and in no rush about it.

animals.name: Shortfin Mako Shark
animals.blurb: Shaped like a torpedo, yet spends most of its life loafing.

animals.name: Humpback Whale
animals.blurb: Crosses entire oceans on migration, singing the whole way.

animals.name: Manatee
animals.blurb: Drifts at walking pace through warm shallows, grazing.

animals.name: Sailfish
animals.blurb: Called the fastest fish alive, but it only ever sprints in short bursts.

animals.name: Bottlenose Dolphin
animals.blurb: Fast, curious, and known to surf the wake of passing ships.

animals.name: Orca
animals.blurb: Travels a hundred miles a day, hunting in coordinated pods.
